statements.status_notes: GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf covers three grpc-go server-side issues fixed in 1.82.1: an xDS RBAC authorization bypass and a related engine panic in internal/xds/rbac (both only reachable when a gRPC server is configured from xDS LDS/RDS updates), and an HTTP/2 Rapid Reset mitigation bypass in the server transport that requires a gRPC server accepting a flood of client-initiated stream resets. kyverno-reports-server never calls grpc.NewServer/Serve and never imports google.golang.org/grpc/xds; its only use of grpc-go is as an outbound client, via k8s.io/apiserver's etcd3 storage backend (k8s.io/apiserver/pkg/storage/storagebackend/factory/etcd3.go), which only builds a grpc.ClientConn (through clientv3.New) to dial etcd. None of the three vulnerable, server-side code paths are ever executed by this binary. Bumping the pinned google.golang.org/grpc dependency to 1.82.1+ was evaluated and rejected: go get -u on that pin (as used by go/bump@v2) forces go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/google.golang.org/grpc/otelgrpc past v0.60.0, which removes the otelgrpc.UnaryClientInterceptor/StreamClientInterceptor functions that the pinned k8s.io/apiserver@v0.29.2 calls directly in etcd3.go, breaking compilation; the only upstream fix for that is bumping k8s.io/apiserver (and the matching k8s.io/* family) to v0.34+, a disproportionate, unrelated major-version change out of scope for this CVE.

temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x ship temporal CLI and schema-tool binaries copied from published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts that still embed google.golang.org/grpc 1.79.3. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps grpc to 1.82.1; clearing this finding for admin-tools requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and grpc 1.82.1.

google.golang.org/grpc 1.81.1 and 1.82.0 are vendored into the reused upstream docker engine stack and buildx apks. Reachability from the shipped binaries is under assessment; remediation requires rebuilding those apks against grpc 1.82.1, which the version tracker will pull in on the next apk bump.
